subject: english
title: 英语二年级上册知识地图
basis: 单元和栏目对齐家长确认的二年级上册英语教材目录，包含各单元的小任务、话题词、歌谣、故事和小项目。定义依据《义务教育英语课程标准（2022年版）》一级准备要求。它是学习框架，不代替学校课本、教师进度和校内评价。每个知识点的 facts 是这一知识点可以核对的事实，出题不得超出这些事实。Unit 1 到 Unit 4 的事实对照家长提供的朗读纸《2A Unit1–Unit4》。Unit 5 到 Unit 10 的句子对照 2024 沪教五四制知识清单里已经读到的原句。

units.name: Unit 1 My morning
units.summary: Making a morning checklist；get up, brush my teeth, wash my face, have breakfast, up and down

units.name: Unit 2 My room

units.name: Unit 3 On the way
units.summary: Making a bookmark；by car, on foot, by bus, underground, metro

units.name: Unit 4 Playing sports
units.summary: Playing a sports board game；run, jump, play ping-pong, play basketball, play football, warm-up

units.name: Unit 5 In the sky
units.summary: Making a sky log；in the sky, star, sun, cloud, moon

units.name: Unit 6 In the sea
units.summary: Making a sea-animal hat；in the sea, seahorse, dolphin, clownfish

units.name: Unit 7 Seasons
units.summary: Playing a seasons bingo game；spring, summer, autumn, winter

units.name: Unit 8 Yummy fruit
units.summary: Making a fruit plate；fruit, apple, pear, banana, grape, orange

units.name: Unit 9 The five senses
units.summary: Using my five senses；smell, taste, touch, see, hear

units.name: Unit 10 This is me
units.summary: Talking about myself；draw a picture, read a book, make breakfast

units.name: 附录
units.summary: Word bank、Mini-project sheets、Cut, make and role-play、Cut and stick、Audio

concepts.name: Our families and friends
concepts.definition: 复习家人和朋友的说法，为后面的单元做准备。会指着照片说这是谁。
concepts.example: This is my family. This is my friend.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: family 是家人，friend 是朋友。
This is my family. 用来介绍家人。
This is my friend. 用来介绍朋友。
要能指着照片说这是谁。
misconceptions: 介绍时只说 This is my family，说不出照片里每个人是谁。
he 和 she 用混，指着妈妈说他。

concepts.name: Small task: Making a morning checklist
concepts.definition: 做一张早晨清单 morning checklist，用 get up、brush my teeth、wash my face、have breakfast 说出早上做的事。
concepts.example: Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是做一张 morning checklist，早晨清单。
清单上用 get up、brush my teeth、wash my face、have breakfast。
说自己的早晨：Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
I'm ready for school 表示准备好去上学。
misconceptions: 只认识了任务名称，清单上的英语短语换个位置就认不出。
做清单只画图，用英语说早上做的事时说不出来。

concepts.name: Topic words: get up, brush my teeth, wash my face, have breakfast, up and down
concepts.definition: 认读 get up、wash my face、brush my teeth、have breakfast、up and down、morning checklist，并会说准备上学的句子。
concepts.example: I'm ready for school, Dad! I'm coming. Let's go!
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: get up 是起床，wash my face 是洗脸，brush my teeth 是刷牙，have breakfast 是吃早饭。
up and down 是上上下下，morning checklist 是早晨清单。
have breakfast 和 eat breakfast 都是吃早饭。
be ready for 后面接名词，表示为某事做好准备。I'm ready for school 是我准备好去上学了。
Up, up, get up. Up and down, brush my teeth. Splish, splash, wash my face. Ready, ready, I'm ready.
Brush your teeth. 可以回答 OK, Mum. I brush my teeth and then wash my face.
I'm ready for school, Dad! I'm coming. Let's go!
Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
misconceptions: 把 brush my teeth 说成 brush teeth，漏掉 my。
动作和意思配错，wash my face 认成洗手。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: Get up
concepts.definition: 跟读《Get up》里起床、刷牙、洗脸和准备好的句子。
concepts.example: Up, up, get up. Ready, ready, I'm ready.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 歌谣要跟读：Up, up, get up. 起来，起来，起床啦。
Up and down, brush my teeth. 上上下下，刷牙啦。
Splish, splash, wash my face. 哗啦哗啦，洗脸啦。
Ready, ready, I'm ready. 准备，准备，我准备好了。
misconceptions: 只跟旋律哼唱，不跟读单词，唱完说不出一个词。
唱快拍子时吞音，get up 唱成一个音。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Shenshen's morning
concepts.definition: 听读《Shenshen's morning》，会跟妈妈说刷牙洗脸，并告诉爸爸准备好去上学。
concepts.example: OK, Mum. I brush my teeth and then wash my face.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 故事《Shenshen's morning》要会读这些句子。
Brush your teeth. OK, Mum. I brush my teeth and then wash my face.
I'm ready for school, Dad! I'm coming. Let's go!
Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
misconceptions: 只听不指，听完说不出故事里谁在说话。
模仿句子时把人名和句子张冠李戴。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My morning checklist
concepts.definition: 完成 My morning checklist，用本单元的句子向别人介绍自己的早晨。
concepts.example: Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My morning checklist。
介绍时说：Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.
还可以说 I'm ready for school.
用到 get up、brush my teeth、wash my face、have breakfast。
misconceptions: 作品做得漂亮，介绍时只会说作品名，说不出里面的内容。
介绍时全用中文，学过的短语一句也用不上。

concepts.name: Small task: Tidying my room
concepts.definition: 整理房间 Tidying my room，用 put … in/on/under … 说出东西放在哪里。
concepts.example: I put my books on the desk. I put my toys in the box.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是整理房间 Tidying my room。
用 put … in/on/under … 说把东西放在里面、上面或下面。
I put my books on the desk. I put my toys in the box.
My room is tidy. I like my room.
misconceptions: 只会把房间摆整齐，用英语说整理步骤的短语说不出。
把任务名读一遍就过，Tidying 只认字形不懂意思。

concepts.name: Topic words: on the desk, in the box, under the bed, on the shelf
concepts.definition: 认读 on the desk、in the box、under the bed、on the shelf，以及 room、tidy、mess，会用 put 和 Where is/are 说位置。
concepts.example: Please put it under the bed.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: on the desk 是在书桌上，in the box 是在盒子里，under the bed 是在床底下，on the shelf 是在架子上。
room 是房间。tidy 是整洁的，也可以表示使整洁。mess 是一团糟。
put 后面接 in、on 或 under，表示把东西放在里面、上面或下面。
Where is 或 Where are 用来问人或东西在哪里。What about …? 是“那……呢？”。
I put my books on the desk. I put my toys in the box. Put the books on the shelf.
What a mess! My room is tidy. Let's tidy the room together.
What about the toys? In the box? Yes, that's right.
I can put the box on the desk. Oh, no. Please put it under the bed.
misconceptions: on、in、under 用混，把在盒子里说成 on the box。
短语说一半，in box 漏掉 the。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: I like my room
concepts.definition: 跟读《I like my room》，会说房间整洁、一起整理。
concepts.example: I like my room. My room is tidy.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 要会说 I like my room. 我喜欢我的房间。
I can tidy my room. 我能整理我的房间。
My room is tidy. 我的房间很整洁。
Let's tidy the room together. 我们一起整理房间吧。
misconceptions: 只跟唱不指词，my 和 your 唱混。
会跟着一起唱，单独问哪一句就答不上。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Where's my ball?
concepts.definition: 听读《Where's my ball?》，用 Where is/are 问位置，并读出书、玩具和盒子各放在哪里。
concepts.example: Please put it under the bed.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 用 Where is 或 Where are 问东西在哪里。
I put my books on the desk. I put my toys in the box.
Put the books on the shelf. 玩具放进盒子：In the box? Yes, that's right.
盒子不要放在书桌上，要放在床底下：Please put it under the bed.
misconceptions: 听故事只找球，没听到球在桌子下面就说在桌子上。
模仿 Where’s my ball? 时丢了 ’s。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My tidy room
concepts.definition: 完成 My tidy room，用 put 的句子介绍自己的房间。
concepts.example: I can tidy my room. I like my room.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My tidy room。
介绍时说 I can tidy my room.
I put my books on the desk. I put my toys in the box.
说完可以加上 I like my room.
misconceptions: 介绍房间作品时只用手比划，位置短语一个也说不出。

concepts.name: Small task: Making a bookmark
concepts.definition: 做书签 bookmark，用 by car、by bus、on foot 说出自己怎么去。
concepts.example: This is a bookmark. I go to school on foot.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是做书签，bookmark 是书签。
介绍时可以说 This is a bookmark. I love this bookmark.
I go to school on foot. 是我步行去学校。I go to school by bus. 是我乘公共汽车去学校。
by car、by bus、on foot 用来说明怎么去。
misconceptions: 做书签只顾涂色，不会用英语说出自己做了什么。

concepts.name: Topic words: by car, on foot, by bus, underground, metro
concepts.definition: 认读 by car、by bus、on foot、on the way、postcard、bookmark、underground、metro，会问怎么去、这是什么。
concepts.example: I go to school on foot. It's the London Underground.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: by car 是乘小汽车，by bus 是乘公共汽车，on foot 是步行，on the way 是在路上。
postcard 是明信片，bookmark 是书签。underground 和 metro 都是地铁。
说出行用 I go … by …。I go to school on foot. I go to school by bus.
What's this? 或 What's that? 问这是什么、那是什么，用 It's … 回答。
在城市前面用 in，例如 in London、in Shanghai。
How do you go? Go by car? Go on foot? OK. Let's go!
Look, your postcard! Yes, you can see them in London.
伦敦地铁是 the London Underground。在上海，地铁说 metro。
misconceptions: by car 和 on foot 用混，把步行说成 by foot。
by bus 说成 on bus 或 in bus。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: Going to school
concepts.definition: 跟读《Going to school》，会问怎么去，并说出步行或乘车上学。
concepts.example: In the morning, I go to school on foot.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: How do you go? Go by car? 你怎么去？乘小汽车去？
Go on foot? OK. Let's go! 步行去？好的。我们走吧！
In the morning, I go to school on foot. 早上，我步行去学校。
I go to school by bus. 我乘公共汽车去学校。
misconceptions: 歌词里的 by car、on foot 唱过就忘，换个顺序认不出。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: A postcard from London
concepts.definition: 听读《A postcard from London》，会读明信片和伦敦地铁、上海 metro 这几句。
concepts.example: Oh, it's the London Underground.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 故事要会读明信片和地铁这几句。
Hi, Lily, how are you? Look, your postcard!
Yes, you can see them in London. I love them, too.
But what's this? Oh, it's the London Underground.
在上海，地铁说 metro：you use metro in Shanghai.
misconceptions: 听故事说不出明信片从哪里寄来。
London 读不出来，直接跳过不读。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My bookmark
concepts.definition: 完成 My bookmark，用 bookmark 和出行的句子介绍自己的书签。
concepts.example: This is a bookmark. I love this bookmark.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My bookmark。
This is a bookmark. I love this bookmark.
接着说自己怎么去：I go to school by bus. 或 I go to school on foot.
bookmark 是书签，postcard 是明信片。
misconceptions: 介绍书签时只会读单词卡，连不成一句话。

concepts.name: Small task: Playing a sports board game
concepts.definition: 玩运动棋盘游戏，用 run、jump 和球类短语说动作，并会说先热身。
concepts.example: Let's play sports. We should do a warm-up.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是玩运动棋盘游戏，board game 是棋盘游戏。
用 run、jump、play football、play basketball、play ping-pong 说动作。
Let's play sports. We should do a warm-up.
I can play ping-pong.
misconceptions: 桌游规则听漏，轮到自己时动作词认不出。

concepts.name: Topic words: run, jump, play ping-pong, play basketball, play football, warm-up
concepts.definition: 认读 run、jump、三种球类、sports、best、very well、should、warm-up、board game。球类前面不加 the。
concepts.example: You can play ping-pong very well. You should do a warm-up.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: run 是跑，jump 是跳，sports 是运动，board game 是棋盘游戏。
play football 是踢足球，play basketball 是打篮球，play ping-pong 是打乒乓球。
play ping-pong 也叫 play table tennis。球类运动前面不加 the。
best 是最好的，very well 是非常好，should 是应该，warm-up 是热身。
Let's 就是 Let us，用来提议一起做。We should … 表示我们应该做某事。
Let's play sports. Here we go. Do our best. We are the best.
You can play ping-pong very well. Can I have a go? Yes, of course. But you should do a warm-up.
The ball's out. 是球出界了。Try again! 是再试一次。
misconceptions: 球类前面漏 play，说成 I basketball。
ping-pong、basketball、football 看图配错。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: Let's play sports
concepts.definition: 跟读《Let's play sports》，会说一起运动、开始、尽力和最棒。
concepts.example: Let's play sports. We are the best.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Let's play sports. 我们一起做运动。
Here we go. 我们开始吧。
Do our best. 尽我们最大的努力。
We are the best. 我们是最棒的。
misconceptions: 跟唱时 play 后面的球类词读串，唱到一半接不上。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Playing ping-pong
concepts.definition: 听读《Playing ping-pong》，会读打得好、先热身、球出界和再试一次。
concepts.example: But you should do a warm-up.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Wow, you can play ping-pong very well. Can I have a go?
Yes, of course. But you should do a warm-up.
Oh, no! The ball's out. 球出界了。
Try again! 再试一次。
misconceptions: 听故事分不清是谁在打球，动作词和人对不上。

concepts.name: Mini-project: A sports board game
concepts.definition: 完成 A sports board game，用运动短语和 should 介绍自己的棋盘。
concepts.example: Let's play sports. I can play football.
concepts.source: 二年级上册英语朗读纸 2A Unit 1–4；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 A sports board game。
board game 是棋盘游戏，sports 是运动。
介绍时说 Let's play sports. I can play ping-pong.
We should do a warm-up. warm-up 是热身。
misconceptions: 做棋盘只顾画格子，格子上的英语词读不出。

concepts.name: Small task: Making a sky log
concepts.definition: 做一张天空记录 sky log，说出天空里看到的星星、太阳、云和月亮。
concepts.example: Look, Shenshen, what do you see in the sky?
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Making a sky log，记下天空里看到的东西。
Look, Shenshen, what do you see in the sky?
Wow! So many stars! They're so high in the sky.
天空里的词是 sky、star、sun、cloud、moon。
misconceptions: 画 sky log 很积极，天上的东西用英语说不出。

concepts.name: Topic words: in the sky, star, sun, cloud, moon
concepts.definition: 认读 sky、star、sun、cloud、moon，并会说太阳、星星和月亮的位置。
concepts.example: The sun is high in the sky.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: sky 是天空，star 是星星，sun 是太阳，cloud 是云，moon 是月亮。
Twinkle, twinkle, little star. 一闪一闪小星星。
Where's Mr Sun? He's behind me. 太阳先生在我后面。
The sun is high in the sky. 太阳高高地在天空中。
The moon is bright. The moon is behind the clouds. 月亮明亮，月亮在云后面。
Look, Shenshen, what do you see in the sky? Wow! So many stars! They're so high in the sky.
misconceptions: sun 和 moon 认混，白天晚上说反。
star 和 cloud 图词配对错。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: Twinkle, twinkle, little star
concepts.definition: 跟读《Twinkle, twinkle, little star》，会唱星星在天上很高。
concepts.example: Twinkle, twinkle, little star. Up above the world so high.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Twinkle, twinkle, little star.
Up above the world so high. 高高地在世界上空。
Like a diamond in the sky. 像天上的一颗钻石。
There are so many stars in the sky. They're very high.
misconceptions: 歌会唱，star 等单词单独拿出来认不出。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Rita and Mr Sun
concepts.definition: 听读《Rita and Mr Sun》，会问太阳在哪里，并说出月亮和云的位置。
concepts.example: Where's Mr Sun? He's behind me.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Where's Mr Sun? He's behind me.
The sun is high in the sky.
The moon is bright.
The moon is behind the clouds.
misconceptions: 把故事里太阳的话当成 Rita 说的，人物搞混。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My sky log
concepts.definition: 完成 My sky log，用看到的天空句子介绍自己的记录。
concepts.example: What do you see in the sky? So many stars!
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My sky log。
介绍时问 What do you see in the sky?
可以说 So many stars! They're so high in the sky.
也可以说 The sun is high in the sky. The moon is behind the clouds.
misconceptions: 介绍 sky log 只会说 It is nice，star、moon 都用不上。

concepts.name: Small task: Making a sea-animal hat
concepts.definition: 做一顶海里动物的帽子，说出海马、小丑鱼在海里做什么。
concepts.example: They are in the sea. Let's play together.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Making a sea-animal hat，做海里动物的帽子。
Swim in the sea. 在海里游泳。
Little seahorses are in the sea.
I like playing hide-and-seek in the sea. Let's play together.
misconceptions: 做帽子只会照着剪，听不懂步骤里的英语指令。

concepts.name: Topic words: in the sea, seahorse, dolphin, clownfish
concepts.definition: 认读 in the sea、seahorse、dolphin、clownfish，并会读海马和小丑鱼的句子。
concepts.example: Hello, Clownfish. Nice to meet you.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: in the sea 是在海里，seahorse 是海马，dolphin 是海豚，clownfish 是小丑鱼。
Swim in the sea.
Little seahorses are in the sea. They live with Papa Seahorse.
This is Papa Seahorse. This is Mama Seahorse.
Mama Seahorse lays eggs. Papa Seahorse hatches the babies and takes care of the babies.
Hello, Little Seahorses. Hello, Clownfish. Nice to meet you.
I like playing hide-and-seek in the sea. I like moving up and down in the sea.
misconceptions: 三个海动物认混，海马、海豚、小丑鱼配错图。
clownfish 太长不敢读，一律说 fish。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: The blue sea
concepts.definition: 跟读《The blue sea》，会说在海里游泳。
concepts.example: Swim in the sea.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 歌谣里有 The blue sea. 蓝色的海。
Swim in the sea. 在海里游泳。
They are in the sea.
I like moving up and down in the sea.
misconceptions: 跟唱 The blue sea 时颜色词含糊带过。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Little seahorses
concepts.definition: 听读《Little seahorses》，会说海马爸爸妈妈和小丑鱼在海里玩。
concepts.example: Papa Seahorse takes care of the babies.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Little seahorses live with Papa Seahorse.
Mama Seahorse lays eggs. Papa Seahorse hatches the babies.
Papa Seahorse takes care of the babies.
Hello, Clownfish. Nice to meet you. I like playing hide-and-seek in the sea.
Great! Let's play together.
misconceptions: 听故事说不清小海马和谁在说话。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My sea-animal hat
concepts.definition: 完成 My sea-animal hat，用海里的句子介绍自己的帽子。
concepts.example: They are in the sea.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My sea-animal hat。
介绍时说 They are in the sea.
可以说 This is Papa Seahorse. Hello, Clownfish.
I like playing hide-and-seek in the sea.
misconceptions: 戴上头饰只会做动作，不会用英语说自己演的是什么动物。

concepts.name: Small task: Playing a seasons bingo game
concepts.definition: 玩四季宾果，说出春天温暖、冬天寒冷，以及喜欢哪个季节。
concepts.example: It's warm in spring. I like autumn.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Playing a seasons bingo game。
It's warm in spring. 春天很温暖。
It's cold in winter. 冬天很冷。
I like autumn. I love to see pretty flowers in spring.
misconceptions: bingo 游戏只看图，听到 winter 反应不过来。

concepts.name: Topic words: spring, summer, autumn, winter
concepts.definition: 认读 spring、summer、autumn、winter，并用 in 说出在某个季节。
concepts.example: I love to see pretty flowers in spring.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: spring 是春天，summer 是夏天，autumn 是秋天，winter 是冬天。
in spring、in summer、in autumn、in winter 表示在这个季节。
I love to see pretty flowers in spring. 我喜欢在春天看美丽的花。
I like autumn. 我喜欢秋天。
It's warm in spring.
It's cold in winter.
misconceptions: autumn 和 spring 认混，季节顺序排错。
winter 读音吞音，读成 winner。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: The four seasons
concepts.definition: 跟读《The four seasons》，会说春天温暖、冬天寒冷。
concepts.example: It's warm in spring. It's cold in winter.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 歌谣说四个季节：spring、summer、autumn、winter。
It's warm in spring.
It's cold in winter.
I love to see pretty flowers in spring.
misconceptions: 四季歌会唱，四个季节词单独认不出。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: The little apple tree
concepts.definition: 听读《The little apple tree》，会说喜欢秋天、春天看花。
concepts.example: I like autumn.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: I like autumn.
I love to see pretty flowers in spring.
It's warm in spring.
It's cold in winter.
misconceptions: 听故事把苹果树的四季变化顺序说乱。

concepts.name: Mini-project: A seasons bingo game
concepts.definition: 完成四季宾果，用季节句子介绍自己抽到的季节。
concepts.example: It's warm in spring. I like autumn.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 A seasons bingo game。
抽到春天说 It's warm in spring.
抽到冬天说 It's cold in winter.
可以说 I like autumn. I love to see pretty flowers in spring.
misconceptions: 做 bingo 卡只在格子里写数字，不敢写英语季节词。

concepts.name: Small task: Making a fruit plate
concepts.definition: 做水果拼盘，说出需要香蕉和苹果。
concepts.example: I need the banana and the apple.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Making a fruit plate，做水果拼盘。
What do you need for the fruit plate?
I need the banana and the apple.
I love fruit.
misconceptions: 摆盘很起劲，介绍拼盘时水果词一个也说不出。

concepts.name: Topic words: fruit, apple, pear, banana, grape, orange
concepts.definition: 认读 fruit、apple、pear、banana、grape、orange，并会说红苹果、黄梨。
concepts.example: I need the banana and the apple.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: fruit 是水果，apple 是苹果，pear 是梨，banana 是香蕉，grape 是葡萄，orange 是橙子。
yummy fruit 是美味的水果。red apples 是红苹果，yellow pears 是黄梨。
Apples red. Apples red.
I love fruit. 我喜欢水果。
What do you need for the fruit plate? I need the banana and the apple.
misconceptions: apple、pear、grape 认混，图和词配错。
banana 拼写写成 bananna。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: I love fruit
concepts.definition: 跟读《I love fruit》，会说苹果红、我喜欢水果。
concepts.example: I love fruit.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Apples red. Apples red. 苹果红。
I love fruit.
red apples 是红苹果，yellow pears 是黄梨。
yummy fruit 是美味的水果。
misconceptions: 跟唱 I love fruit 时把 love 和 like 唱混。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Shenshen's fruit plate
concepts.definition: 听读《Shenshen's fruit plate》，会问拼盘需要什么并回答香蕉和苹果。
concepts.example: What do you need for the fruit plate?
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: What do you need for the fruit plate?
I need the banana and the apple.
I love fruit.
red apples、yellow pears 可以放进拼盘。
misconceptions: 说不清拼盘里有哪几种水果，总漏一两种。

concepts.name: Mini-project: My fruit plate
concepts.definition: 完成 My fruit plate，用需要的水果句子介绍自己的拼盘。
concepts.example: I need the banana and the apple. I love fruit.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 My fruit plate。
介绍时说 I love fruit.
What do you need for the fruit plate? I need the banana and the apple.
可以说 red apples 和 yellow pears。
misconceptions: 介绍作品只会说 It is a fruit plate，上面的水果说不出。

concepts.name: Small task: Using my five senses
concepts.definition: 用五种感官说出闻到花、尝到水果、摸到草、看见湖、听见鸟。
concepts.example: I smell the flowers. I hear the birds.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Using my five senses。
I smell the flowers. 我闻花。
I taste the fruit. 我尝水果。
I touch the grass. I see the lake. I hear the birds.
misconceptions: 五个感官词和动作对不上，smell 认成摸一摸。

concepts.name: Topic words: smell, taste, touch, see, hear
concepts.definition: 认读 smell、taste、touch、see、hear，并会说五种感官各感知什么。
concepts.example: I smell the flowers. I hear the birds.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: smell 是闻，taste 是尝，touch 是摸，see 是看见，hear 是听见。
I smell the flowers.
I taste the fruit.
I touch the grass.
I see the lake.
I hear the birds.
misconceptions: taste 和 touch 认混，尝和摸配错。
smell 读音读成 smile。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: In the park
concepts.definition: 跟读《In the park》，会说闻花、听见鸟。
concepts.example: I smell the flowers. I hear the birds.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: I smell the flowers.
I taste the fruit.
I touch the grass.
I see the lake. I hear the birds.
misconceptions: In the park 歌会唱，里面的感官词认不出。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: Fun in the rain
concepts.definition: 听读《Fun in the rain》，用五种感官说出感知到的东西。
concepts.example: I smell the flowers. I hear the birds.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: I smell the flowers.
I taste the fruit.
I touch the grass.
I see the lake. I hear the birds.
misconceptions: 听故事说不出下雨天里大家做了什么。

concepts.name: Mini-project: Talking about the five senses
concepts.definition: 完成五感介绍，把闻到、尝到、摸到、看见、听见的句子说出来。
concepts.example: I smell the flowers. I hear the birds.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目是 Talking about the five senses。
I smell the flowers. I taste the fruit.
I touch the grass. I see the lake.
I hear the birds.
misconceptions: 介绍五感时只会数数字，五个动作词说不上来。

concepts.name: Small task: Talking about myself
concepts.definition: 介绍自己会做的事：画画、看书、做早饭。
concepts.example: Look at me. I can draw a picture.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小任务是 Talking about myself。
Look at me. 看我。
I can draw a picture. I can read a book.
I can make breakfast.
misconceptions: 自我介绍只报名字，本单元的活动词用不上。

concepts.name: Topic words: draw a picture, read a book, make breakfast
concepts.definition: 认读 draw a picture、read a book、make breakfast，并用 I can 说出自己会做的事。
concepts.example: I can draw a picture. I can make breakfast.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: draw a picture 是画画，read a book 是看书，make breakfast 是做早饭。
special 是特别的。take care of 是照顾，do kung fu 是练功夫。
Look at me.
I can 后面接动词原形，表示我会做这件事。
I can draw a picture. I can read a book. I can make breakfast.
misconceptions: draw a picture 说成 draw picture，漏 a。
read a book 和 make breakfast 意思配错。

concepts.name: Song/Rhyme/Chant time: Look at me
concepts.definition: 跟读《Look at me》，会说看我、我会画画。
concepts.example: Look at me. I can draw a picture.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Look at me.
I can draw a picture.
I can read a book.
I can make breakfast.
misconceptions: Look at me 会唱，me 和 my 唱混。

concepts.name: Talking/Story time: I'm special
concepts.definition: 听读《I'm special》，用 I can 说出自己特别会做的事。
concepts.example: Look at me. I can draw a picture.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: Look at me.
I can draw a picture. I can read a book. I can make breakfast.
take care of 是照顾，do kung fu 是练功夫。
I can 后面接动词原形。
misconceptions: 听故事说不出“我”特别在哪里。

concepts.name: Mini-project: A mini-book about me
concepts.definition: 做一本关于自己的小书，用 I can 介绍里面的事。
concepts.example: Look at me. I can draw a picture.
concepts.source: 沪教版（五四制）（2024）二年级上册知识清单；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 小项目的名称是 A mini-book about me。
Look at me.
I can draw a picture. I can read a book.
I can make breakfast.
misconceptions: 小书只贴照片，介绍时说不出照片里的活动。

concepts.name: Word bank
concepts.definition: 用单词表按单元复习本册单词，看到单词能读出来并说出意思。
concepts.example: Read a word from the word bank.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 单词表按单元列出本册要认读的单词。
看到单词要能读出来。
还要能说出单词的中文意思。
misconceptions: 单词表只从头顺读，不熟的词一直跳过。
看到单词读得出，遮住中文说不出意思。

concepts.name: Mini-project sheets
concepts.definition: 使用小项目练习纸，按步骤完成本册的制作活动。
concepts.example: Follow a mini-project sheet.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 这一项的名称是“Mini-project sheets”。
听懂要做什么，并用本单元的词说一说。
misconceptions: 练习纸只做手工部分，朗读和说话步骤跳过。

concepts.name: Cut, make and role-play
concepts.definition: 剪下图卡，做一做、演一演本册的对话。
concepts.example: Cut the card and act out a line.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 剪下图卡，做一做、演一演本册的对话。
演出的句子用学过的词。
能说出自己演的是哪一句。
misconceptions: 剪贴完就收起来，不演对话。
演对话只会自己那句，接不上别人的话。

concepts.name: Cut and stick
concepts.definition: 剪贴图卡，把单词和图配对。
concepts.example: Stick the word next to its picture.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 剪贴图卡，把单词和图配对。
单词贴在对应的图旁边。
配完要能读出那个单词。
misconceptions: 图词配对靠图标猜，不看单词本身。

concepts.name: Audio
concepts.definition: 听本册音频，跟读单词、歌谣和对话。
concepts.example: Listen and repeat the audio.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 听本册音频，跟读单词、歌谣和对话。
跟读的是本册学过的内容。
听完要能自己再说一遍。
misconceptions: 听音频只当背景音，不跟读。
听不懂就关掉，不愿再听第二遍。

concepts.name: Colours
concepts.definition: 认读颜色词，能说出物品是什么颜色。
concepts.example: It is red. It is blue.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: red 是红色，blue 是蓝色。
用 It is red. 或 It is blue. 说物品的颜色。
看到物品要能说出它是什么颜色。
misconceptions: 颜色词认混，red、green 分不清。
说物品颜色时只蹦一个词，忘了 It is… 。

concepts.name: Numbers
concepts.definition: 认读数字词，能按顺序数一数。
concepts.example: One, two, three.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: one 是一，two 是二，three 是三。
数字词要按顺序数。
例如：One, two, three.
misconceptions: 数字词会背不会用，看到数量反应不出英语。
three 和 tree 听混，数数接龙到十几就卡。

concepts.name: Letters
concepts.definition: 认读字母，能按顺序把字母读出来。
concepts.example: A, B, C.
concepts.source: 家长确认的教材目录（二年级上册英语）；英语课标（2022年版）一级准备
facts: 字母要按顺序认读。
开头是 A、B、C。
看到字母能读出来。
misconceptions: 字母歌会唱，单个字母拿出来认不出。
b 和 d、p 和 q 认混。

objectives.title: Starter: Our families and friends
objectives.goal: 能指着照片用英语说出家人和朋友。
questionPoints: 指着照片说家人和朋友，不考拼写
he、she 的题配图区分
只考本册学过的词和短句

objectives.title: Unit 1 My morning
objectives.goal: 能认读 get up、brush my teeth、wash my face、have breakfast，并说 I'm ready for school 和自己的早晨。
questionPoints: 早上活动的短语按动作顺序出，配动作图
brush my teeth 里的 my 不能丢
have breakfast 和 eat breakfast 都算吃早饭
说早晨用 Look! This is my morning. I get up, and then brush my teeth.

objectives.title: Unit 2 My room
objectives.goal: 能认读 on the desk、in the box、under the bed、on the shelf，并用 put 说出东西放在哪里。
questionPoints: on、in、under 配图考，先不靠中文翻译
听指令把东西放到正确位置
答句用朗读纸里的句子，如 I put my books on the desk.
架子上是 on the shelf，床底下是 under the bed

objectives.title: Unit 3 On the way
objectives.goal: 能认读 by car、on foot、by bus，并说出伦敦地铁 underground 和上海的 metro。
questionPoints: by car、on foot、by bus 配交通图认读
on foot 不能说成 by foot
能接上 I go to school 说一整句
伦敦地铁是 underground，上海说 metro

objectives.title: Unit 4 Playing sports
objectives.goal: 能认读 run、jump 和三种球类，并说出打球前要 do a warm-up。
questionPoints: 看图说动作、听词做动作两个方向都练
play 和球类词成组记，球类前面不加 the
play ping-pong 也叫 play table tennis
建议先热身：You should do a warm-up.

objectives.title: Unit 5 In the sky
objectives.goal: 能认读 in the sky, star, sun, cloud, moon，并完成“Making a sky log”和“My sky log”。
questionPoints: star、sun、cloud、moon 图词配对
sun 和 moon 放在白天黑夜场景里区分
star 只要求认读

objectives.title: Unit 6 In the sea
objectives.goal: 能认读 in the sea, seahorse, dolphin, clownfish，并完成“Making a sea-animal hat”和“My sea-animal hat”。
questionPoints: 三个海动物词连图一起记
clownfish 等长词只要求认读
回答用整句 This is a dolphin.

objectives.title: Unit 7 Seasons
objectives.goal: 能认读 spring, summer, autumn, winter，并完成“Playing a seasons bingo game”和“A seasons bingo game”。
questionPoints: 四季按顺序出，先认后说
听到季节词马上指图
结合 bingo 玩法练反应

objectives.title: Unit 8 Yummy fruit
objectives.goal: 能认读 fruit, apple, pear, banana, grape, orange，并完成“Making a fruit plate”和“My fruit plate”。
questionPoints: 水果词配实物图，先听说后拼写
a pear、an apple 的说法在句子里带出来
能用 I like… 说喜欢的水果

objectives.title: Unit 9 The five senses
objectives.goal: 能认读 smell, taste, touch, see, hear，并完成“Using my five senses”和“Talking about the five senses”。
questionPoints: 感官词配动作做一做
smell、taste、touch 用不同场景区分
句子只用本单元词：I can see…

objectives.title: Unit 10 This is me
objectives.goal: 能认读 draw a picture, read a book, make breakfast，并完成“Talking about myself”和“A mini-book about me”。
questionPoints: 活动词配上自己的真实生活
介绍时把 I like… 说完整
不要求拼写，重点在开口说

objectives.title: 附录
objectives.goal: 能用单词表、练习纸、图卡和音频复习本册内容。
questionPoints: 单词表抽认，先认后读
音频跟读每天一遍，短时高频
图卡配对和剪贴结合着做

objectives.title: 其他栏目
objectives.goal: 能认读颜色、数字和字母。
questionPoints: 字母认读和音序跟读
颜色词配身边实物说
数字词对着实物数量数
